item: card audit n units + comparison rows; day-counts serve lets the request deadline through
summary: Field test 2026-11-14 rows 79-80. Card audit compared every card's n with its article-id count, but on diet_self_audit, capacity_implausible, echo_chamber, story_lineage (sources), rising, emotion_profile, supergroup_rising (mentions), price_narrative (days), buried_topic and severity_alert n counts something else, so every such card reported a mismatch; N_COUNTS_BY_TYPE now says what n counts, only articles cards are compared (against their own article_ids, not evidence ids) and a test fails when a card type with ids is undeclared. Arithmetic: comparison rows with a verdict (24.21 >= 8 x 2.14 check) are recomputed and the tick checked, with a rounding band that leaves a too-close call undecided; quantity_rows_n separates rows with nothing to recompute (155 of 170 rows in the bundles on hand). day_counts.windowed_counts re-raises once the enclosing statement deadline has passed, so the request's own stop becomes the StatementTimeout it is instead of a 'serve failed' warning followed by a live scan with no time left; it also returns None at once when trending's budget is spent. Orphan keywords 2-175: residue between 12-hour prune passes (re-index, fold), no change.
